integrity: Algebraic proof with reproducible finite checks; finite computations are not offered as a universal proof. Historical source comparisons are qualified by material read.
scientific_limitations: Only odd rational primes and the polynomial X^p-pX over Z/p^kZ; no fiber census, no extension to p=2. Earlier Galois-ring Dickson literature is a priority risk for the p=3 specialization. Historical originality and independent validation are not guaranteed.
title: Exact prime-power value sets of a Frobenius-minus-linear polynomial
